description: Clean-room SCADA/DCS runtime (Wonderware / Ignition / DeltaV class): deterministic scan-cycle tag engine, ISA-18.2 alarm state machine with deadband and on/off delays, PID control loops with anti-windup, a historian answering time-weighted aggregate queries, and a Modbus holding-register image. Almost everything is exactly computable from a fully specified scan semantics, so the alarm journal, historian results and register image are graded with no tolerance at all; only the PID float outputs carry a 1e-9 band.
source: fully specified scan/alarm/PID semantics in the spec; reference implementation cross-checked against hand-computed event sequences
